title: Manipur: Normal life affected due to bandh in Kangpokpi district over woman’s death

ai.summary: A 48-hour shutdown was called by the Kangpokpi-based Committee on Tribal Unity (COTU) in Manipur following a woman's death during a firing incident at Taphou Kuki village, affecting transportation and markets.

facts.claim: A 48-hour shutdown was called by the Kangpokpi-based Committee on Tribal Unity (COTU) in Manipur following a woman's death during a firing incident at Taphou Kuki village
facts.quote: Kangpokpi-based Committee on Tribal Unity (COTU) called the 48-hour shutdown from November 12 midnight, following the gunfight in the vicinity of Taphou Kuki village on Thursday morning.
Buses and autorickshaws remained off the roads, inconveniencing commuters. Markets also remained shut.

ai.background_note: The shutdown was called by the Committee on Tribal Unity (COTU) in response to a woman's death during a firing incident at Taphou Kuki village, which they attributed to security forces under the superintendent of police (SP) in Kangpokpi district.
